title: White Mining Lines
description: Replaces Minecraft's default mining cracks with clean white mining lines for a modern and minimal look.
body:
White Mining Lines

White Mining Lines is a lightweight vanilla-friendly resource pack that replaces Minecraft's default dark block-breaking cracks with clean white mining lines.

The default mining overlay can sometimes be difficult to see on certain blocks or simply not match a clean resource pack setup. This pack gives the mining animation a fresh, minimal appearance while keeping the original mining progression intact.

Features
Clean white mining lines
Visible mining progress on all blocks
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Vanilla-style experience
Works in Survival and Creative mode
Compatible with most resource packs
No mods required
Compatibility
Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x
Works on singleplayer and multiplayer servers
Compatible with Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Quilt, Paper, Spigot, Purpur, and vanilla clients
What Does This Pack Change?

This pack only changes the block-breaking overlay (destroy_stage_0 through destroy_stage_9).

It does not modify:

Block textures
Item textures
Models
User interface
Sounds
Gameplay mechanics
Perfect For
Vanilla+ players
Minimalist resource pack users
PvP players who want a cleaner mining overlay
Builders who prefer a modern look
Players creating custom pack combinations
Installation
Download the resource pack.
Place the ZIP file into your .minecraft/resourcepacks folder.
Open Minecraft.
Go to Options → Resource Packs.
Enable White Mining Lines.
Enjoy a cleaner mining experience.
Credits

Created by Noxav.

Thank you for downloading White Mining Lines! Feedback and suggestions are always welcome.
